mission.title: Red Team Foundation Roadmap: 90 Days → Full-Time Specialization

phases.name: Month 1: Technical Foundations
phases.description: Understand the systems that security professionals assess.

phases.name: Month 2: Operating Systems & Programming
phases.description: Understand the technology that attackers and defenders work with.

phases.name: Month 3: Red Team Methodology
phases.description: Connect your technical knowledge with practical security assessments.

weeks.title: Computer & Networking Fundamentals
weeks.summary: How computers communicate, client-server architecture, IP/MAC, DNS & DHCP.
weeks.goal: Understand what happens when you enter a website address into your browser.

weeks.title: Networking Deeper & Packet Analysis
weeks.summary: OSI vs TCP/IP, TCP vs UDP, ports & protocols, subnetting, HTTP/TLS.
weeks.goal: Capture network traffic using Wireshark and trace DNS queries and TCP connections.

weeks.title: Linux Fundamentals
weeks.summary: Filesystem hierarchy, terminal commands, files, users, groups, permissions.
weeks.goal: Become comfortable navigating Linux without relying on the graphical interface.

weeks.title: Linux Administration
weeks.summary: Processes, services, SSH, package management, system logs, environment variables.
weeks.goal: Understand what is happening inside a Linux machine and solve Bandit challenges.

weeks.title: Windows Fundamentals & Active Directory
weeks.summary: Windows architecture, users, NTFS permissions, processes, Event Viewer, PowerShell, AD.
weeks.goal: Understand how Windows manages users, processes and permissions.

weeks.title: Python & Bash Scripting
weeks.summary: Variables, data types, loops, functions, file I/O, regex, JSON, Bash automation.
weeks.goal: Write small scripts that automate administrative tasks and analyze log files.

weeks.title: Web Development & Application Architecture
weeks.summary: HTTP request/response, verbs, cookies, sessions, auth, REST APIs, SQL databases.
weeks.goal: Understand how a login system and web application work internally.

weeks.title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
weeks.summary: CIA Triad, threats, vulnerabilities, exploits, hashing vs encryption, NIST SP 800-115.
weeks.goal: Understand what a security assessment is, how it is planned and rules of engagement.

weeks.title: Network Reconnaissance
weeks.summary: Network discovery, port states, service identification, enumeration, Nmap usage.
weeks.goal: Assess your own machine or an intentionally vulnerable lab.

weeks.title: Web Application Security
weeks.summary: OWASP Top 10, SQL injection, XSS, Broken Access Control, Burp Suite intro.
weeks.goal: Complete beginner PortSwigger Web Security Academy labs.

weeks.title: Red Team Concepts & MITRE ATT&CK
weeks.summary: Red vs Blue vs Purple teams, threat modeling, attack lifecycles, MITRE ATT&CK.
weeks.goal: Understand how adversary behavior is categorized and how defenders detect it.

weeks.title: Capstone Security Assessment Project
weeks.summary: Build a controlled security lab with OWASP Juice Shop, scope, exploit & report.
weeks.goal: Produce a complete professional security assessment report.
